pairs.subject: sql-console
pairs.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/characters/RulesTab.tsx:25 The page reads character data through named, typed daemon RPCs and never takes user-typed SQL against an external database; a case-insensitive search of all files in apps/console/src/pages/characters found zero hits for sql, information_schema, safeMode, dialect and introspect, so the subject's precondition does not hold.

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/characters/RulesTab.tsx:28 Writes are named RPC mutations with structured params; there is no statement string to classify as read or mutating.
apps/console/src/pages/characters/routes.ts:8 The tab list that follows covers character package documents, rules, tones, voice and moderation; none is a schema browser or catalog view.

crates/shadowrunr-brain/Cargo.toml:18 The only SQL engine in the repo is one bundled SQLite memory index the app owns, which is data-access scope; there are no connector families. A search of apps and crates found no postgres, mysql or connection-string use.

apps/console/src/pages/characters/SituationsTab.tsx:91 Input on this page is pickers and form fields like this tournament select; there is no SQL editing surface. The console app's dependencies include no code editor.
apps/console/src/pages/characters/RulesTab.tsx:7 The page renders fixed contract types, not arbitrary engine rows with NULLs, truncation bounds or engine errors.
